invariants.description: O2 mass balance: V (C_O2_c(t) - C_O2_c(0)) = time integral of v_in C_O2_a - v_out C_O2_v - flux_O2_c (trapezoid)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(V*(C_O2_c - C_O2_c[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_in*C_O2_a - v_out*C_O2_v - flux_O2_c)[1:] + (v_in*C_O2_a - v_out*C_O2_v - flux_O2_c)[:-1])))))) <= 2e-3*max(np.max(np.abs(V*(C_O2_c - C_O2_c[0]))), 1e-30) + 1e-24

invariants.description: flux law flux_O2_c = 2 pi r L perm_O2 (ub_O2_c - ub_O2_t)
Spencer inverse is exact: forward curve (mmHg form) at (P_O2_c, P_CO2_c) returns C_O2_c
free O2 ub = 133.32 P S (mmHg -> Pa)
Pade Lambert-W: when the exponential branch is active the axial profile mean matches C_0: (1 - exp(-k L))/(k L) = C_0 (Pade error < 1%)
invariants.expr: np.all(np.where((ub_O2_c < exp_threshold*ub_O2_a) & (C_0 > 0.05) & (C_0 < 0.95), np.abs((1 - np.exp(-k_xdecay*L))/(k_xdecay*L) - C_0) <= 1e-2*C_0, True))

invariants.description: physical ordering: at the venous (outlet) end the O2 pressure is not above the capillary mean (P_O2_v <= P_O2_c) after the initial transient
venous free O2 lies between tissue and arterial free O2 (while ub_O2_c < ub_O2_a); contents and pressures >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(np.where(ub_O2_c < ub_O2_a, (ub_O2_v >= ub_O2_t - 1e-12) & (ub_O2_v <= ub_O2_a + 1e-12), True)) & np.all(C_O2_c >= 0) & np.all(P_O2_c >= 0) & np.all(C_O2_v >= 0)

bc_sweep.rationale: Arterial O2 content 5-8.9 mol/m3 (P_O2 ~ 30-150 mmHg), CO2 19-24 mol/m3, tissue P_O2 ~4-37 mmHg, permeability over 1.5 decades around the placeholder; geometry and flows swept by the default factors (0.5-2x).
